subject: Bridge letter / interim coverage clarification for SOC 2 period gap (Sunrise Systems)
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@sunrise-systems.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jun 2028 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: bridge letter to cover post-report SOC 2 gap

Hi Ben,

Thanks for taking this. Sunrise Systems is in the final stages of procurement for a platform contract and our security team and auditors have asked for an interim attestation (bridge letter) because Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report ends 2023-12-31. They want written confirmation of controls coverage for the period between the report end date and our contract start (targeted 2028-07-15).

Key asks from our side:
- A one-page bridge letter confirming there were no changes in scope that would materially affect the asserted controls for the period 2024-01-01 through 2028-07-15 (or clearly listing any exceptions).
- Evidence pointers (what artifacts you can provide): e.g., KMS rotation logs, change-control summaries, incident logs, uptime/availability dashboard link.
- A point of contact for an auditor follow-up (Moss & Co may reach out).

Can you let me know whether Redwood can provide a signed bridge letter and a small bundle of artifacts?

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Head of Risk & Compliance
Sunrise Systems

--
Elena also copied procurement: procurement@sunrise-systems.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@sunrise-systems.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jun 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: bridge letter to cover post-report SOC 2 gap

Elena — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Laura from Legal & Trust so we can confirm wording and sign-off.

Short answers up front:
- Yes, Redwood can provide a limited bridge letter for the requested interim period.
- We can bundle supporting artifacts: the SOC 2 report PDF, KMS key-rotation summary, a concise change control log for the relevant services, and an availability extract for the last 12 months.

Before we finalize the draft, quick clarifying Qs so we scope correctly:
1) Do your auditors require the bridge to explicitly reference specific Trust Services Criteria or is a general controls continuity statement acceptable?
2) You mentioned Moss & Co — do you expect them to call for raw logs or only summary artifacts?
3) Confirm the latest date you need covered — your note suggested a target contract start of 2028-07-15. Do you need coverage through that start date or through 2028-07-31 (end of month)?

I attached our SOC 2 Type II report (Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_20231231.pdf) for quick reference. Laura — can you advise on the standard bridge template we use and whether we need executive signature vs. Legal signature?

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_20231231.pdf)

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@sunrise-systems.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@sunrise-systems.com
Date: Sat, 01 Jul 2028 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: bridge letter to cover post-report SOC 2 gap

Ben / Laura,

Thanks — quick answers from our side:
- Our external auditor (Moss & Co) prefers the bridge to reference the same common criteria as the SOC 2 (security + availability). A general continuity statement is usually accepted but they like a sentence naming the criteria.
- Moss & Co has asked for summary artifacts only (not raw, production logs). They want: KMS key rotation summary, change-control audit log (high-level), and any incident/response summaries since 2024-01-01. They may request to validate hashes but have indicated they're comfortable with zipped summary files.
- We need coverage through 2028-07-31 (end of month) — procurement needs that for their cutover.

I've attached our purchase order and procurement contact for signature routing (PO_6789.pdf). Ideally we get a signed bridge letter by 2028-07-08 so our lawyers have time to review.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Elena
(Attachment: PO_6789.pdf)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@sunrise-systems.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Jul 2028 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Draft bridge letter + request for legal sign-off (Sunrise Systems)

Hi Laura / Jordan —

Per Elena's ask, I've drafted the attached bridge letter in our standard interim format and included a short artifacts bundle we can provide:
- Bridge_Letter_Draft_Sunrise_20280630.docx (draft wording)
- evidence-KMS-logs-2028-06.zip (summary only)
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_20231231.pdf (already shared)

Draft summary of proposed wording (excerpt):
"Redwood Inference confirms that, between 2024-01-01 and 2028-07-31, there were no material changes to the in-scope services that would adversely affect the design or operating effectiveness of the controls described in Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report dated 2023-12-31, except as noted below (if any). This letter is provided solely for the benefit of Sunrise Systems and the stated auditors for the purpose of procurement review and does not constitute a re-issuance of the SOC report."

Ask: can Legal confirm the excerpt above is acceptable, and confirm who should sign (General Counsel vs. Head of Trust). Also confirm if we need to add the link to our availability dashboard or provide a screenshot instead.

Timeline proposed:
- Legal sign-off by 2028-07-05
- Signed PDF returned to Elena by 2028-07-08

Elena — once Laura confirms, we'll finalize and route for signature. If Moss & Co wants to validate anything else, loop them in and we'll coordinate a narrow scope call.

Thanks —
Ben
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
(Attachments: Bridge_Letter_Draft_Sunrise_20280630.docx, evidence-KMS-logs-2028-06.zip)
